house_elena.name: Elena & Lila's Apartment
house_elena.description: A bright second-floor apartment with art on every wall and the smell of oil paint and coffee.

house_marcus.name: Marcus & Zoe's Place
house_marcus.description: A tidy apartment with workout equipment in the living room and Zoe's college textbooks stacked everywhere.

house_helen.name: Helen & Alice's Cottage
house_helen.description: A warm cottage with a flower garden, bookshelves, and the aroma of freshly baked cookies.

house_diana.name: Diana & Marco's House
house_diana.description: A practical family home above the grocery store. Marco's room is covered in game posters.

house_kai.name: Kai's Studio
house_kai.description: A small studio apartment crammed with musical instruments, vinyl records, and empty coffee cups.

house_priya.name: Priya & Nina's Flat
house_priya.description: A modern flat kept immaculately clean. Family photos on one side, property listings on the other.

house_james.name: James & Theo's House
house_james.description: A worn but comfortable house with a porch. Tools in the garage, beer in the fridge.

house_rosa.name: Rosa & Omar's Home
house_rosa.description: A cozy home that always smells of cooking. Spices from two continents line the kitchen shelves.

house_yuki.name: Yuki & Devon's Apartment
house_yuki.description: A minimalist apartment with a meditation corner on one side and newspaper clippings on the other.

house_frank.name: Frank, George & Sam's Row House
house_frank.description: A row of three connected units on the quiet end of the south side. Frank's garage is always open.

apartment_block_1.name: Northside Apartments
apartment_block_1.description: A modern four-story apartment building with a rooftop terrace and shared laundry room.

apartment_block_2.name: Southside Apartments
apartment_block_2.description: A brick apartment building with a courtyard garden and friendly neighbors who watch out for each other.

apartment_block_3.name: Central Apartments
apartment_block_3.description: A newly renovated building right off the town square. Convenient but noisy on weekends.

cafe.name: The Daily Grind
cafe.description: A warm, bustling cafe with mismatched furniture and the aroma of fresh coffee. The local gossip hub.

grocery.name: Green Basket Market
grocery.description: A neighborhood grocery store with fresh produce and a friendly owner who knows everyone by name.

bar.name: The Rusty Anchor
bar.description: A dimly lit bar with a jukebox, pool table, and regulars who've been coming for years. Lively at night.

restaurant.name: Mama Rosa's Kitchen
restaurant.description: A family-run Italian restaurant with checkered tablecloths and the best pasta in town.

bakery.name: Golden Crust Bakery
bakery.description: A charming bakery with a glass display of fresh pastries. The smell of bread draws people in from the street.

cinema.name: Starlight Cinema
cinema.description: A vintage two-screen cinema with red velvet seats and a popcorn machine that never stops.

office.name: The Hive Coworking
office.description: An open-plan coworking space with standing desks, meeting rooms, and a perpetually broken printer.

office_tower.name: Pinnacle Tower
office_tower.description: A sleek glass office building housing law firms, tech startups, and financial advisors across six floors.

factory.name: Ironworks Factory
factory.description: A large industrial building with a loading dock, welding bays, and the constant hum of machinery.

school.name: Soci Elementary & High
school.description: A two-story school building with a playground, science lab, and the sound of a bell every hour.

hospital.name: Soci City Hospital
hospital.description: A small community hospital with an ER, a few wards, and a cafeteria that serves surprisingly good soup.

park.name: Willow Park
park.description: A green park with old willow trees, a pond, benches, and a small playground. Popular for morning jogs and evening walks.

gym.name: Iron & Grit Gym
gym.description: A no-nonsense gym with free weights, treadmills, and a boxing ring in the back.

library.name: Soci Public Library
library.description: A quiet library with tall shelves, reading nooks, and a community board. Hosts book clubs and events.

church.name: St. Mary's Church
church.description: A stone church with stained glass windows, a quiet garden, and community gatherings every Sunday.

town_square.name: Town Square
town_square.description: The heart of Soci City. A cobblestone plaza with a fountain, benches, a notice board, and a weekend farmers market.

sports_field.name: Community Sports Field
sports_field.description: A large grassy field with soccer goals, a running track, and bleachers. Busy on evenings and weekends.

street_north.name: North Main Street
street_north.description: The main street running through the northern part of town. Shops, cafes, and foot traffic.

street_south.name: South Main Street
street_south.description: The southern stretch of main street. More residential, with the bar and gym nearby.

street_east.name: East Avenue
street_east.description: A quieter avenue on the east side of town, near the hospital and office towers.

street_west.name: West Avenue
street_west.description: A tree-lined avenue on the west side, near the school and sports fields.

apt_northeast.name: Eastview Terrace
apt_northeast.description: A modern apartment block in the northeast corner, popular with hospital staff and factory workers.

apt_northwest.name: Hilltop Gardens
apt_northwest.description: A quiet residential complex on the northwest hilltop, overlooking the school and church.

apt_southeast.name: Riverside Commons
apt_southeast.description: A lively apartment complex near the sports field and factory district, popular with young workers.

apt_southwest.name: Orchard Hill Flats
apt_southwest.description: A peaceful residential block on the southwest edge of town, close to the library and park.

diner.name: Blue Moon Diner
diner.description: A classic diner open early to late. Strong coffee, big plates, and regulars who treat it like a second home.

pharmacy.name: SociMed Pharmacy
pharmacy.description: A neighborhood pharmacy where the pharmacist knows everyone by name and stocks good candy.
